claim: Bounded probe; no theorem activated. On S3_3((3_1)^#k) and S3_3((8_18)^#k) (first homology Z/3) the span of the twisted obstruction classes grows as 2k, section-independently, but block-diagonally (connected sums), so counts factorize; it is 0 on (4_1)^#k, on tripled cycles, and for the easy-action control. conclusion: The effective obstruction grows on a valid bounded-homology family but only block-diagonally; no hardness signal; the smallest missing test is a family with non-block twisted cup products.
